criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.assessment: Official Purdue GIS FID 926 names BLDG_ABBR AACC and Asian American Resource and Cultural Center at 915 Fifth Street. The saved polygon is in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326); after applying the project-local conversion and subtracting the GIS bounding-box center, its 20 unique ring vertices agree with the asset's exact GIS-perimeter plinth to 0.000000231 m maximum bidirectional nearest-vertex distance. This validates the GIS perimeter/plinth; it does not prove the different structural wall line, which remains uncertain.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.assessment: The master contains one Placement_asian_american_resource_and_cultural_center marker at [-335.25091552734375, 192.3804473876953, 0.0]; its campus XY differs from the manifest placement origin by [-1.37e-05, -2.7e-06] m, with zero rotation, unit scale, and the expected relative asset link. The GIS-derived local origin and polygon establish plan orientation/scale for the plinth. The interpreted house walls/porch and height dimensions were reconstructed from photos rather than measured plans, and the model's modifier-evaluated local bounds differ from manifest local bounds by up to 0.0300 m per axis.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.assessment: Purdue exterior photos and facility-page snapshots show a two-storey house with a steep shingle gable roof; the model reflects those features. GIS NUM_LEVELS and CountOfFLO both say 1 floor(s), conflicting with the visible two stories, while Extrution=12 has no documented units. Model total height is 10.05 m and its eave/ridge/chimney heights remain photo estimates; no surveyed vertical datum or measured architectural plan was found.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.assessment: The official Purdue AAARCC gallery photos support white horizontal clapboard, multi-pane sash windows, front porch/entry, shingle gable roof, chimney, and the Fifth Street sign. The saved preview visibly includes these elements. Purdue Emergency Preparedness provides separate front, accessible, and rear kitchen exit descriptions; the builder models the Fifth Street entrance, ramp/accessible door, and rear door. Interior room furniture/partition positions are schematic, not judged as measured.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.assessment: A fresh Blender 4.5.15 reopen found 433 objects ({'MESH': 432, 'FONT': 1}); names and count match the current manifest. The master has one relative linked collection instance. There are 0 unmaterialed meshes, 0 external libraries, and 0 unpacked file-image dependencies. An independent collection-only export was saved and reopened with 433 objects and no cameras/lights. Source records, raw GIS, current facility/emergency-page snapshots, photos, builder, manifest snapshot, preview and probes are in this packet. The current asset hash is fb7a209d1e5c025757afe7bb66e94f498b0b07cf0a464baa693bd5a5c7e58cbb.

source.name: Asian American Resource and Cultural Center

evidence.footprint_method: Transform WGS84 lon/lat using the exact campus local approximation documented in modular/AGENTS.md; center on transformed source feature bounding box; compare all ring vertices to the named GIS plinth mesh vertices. Bidirectional nearest-vertex check, not IoU.

findings: GIS identity and outline are strongly supported, and the saved plinth reproduces the official polygon. The GIS source is a building-shape feature, not a structural wall survey; the builder interprets part of the footprint as porch/projection space, so the exact wall-versus-covered-porch line is not verified.

The model is correctly placed through the master marker and has a relative collection link. Manifest count/name contract matches the current 433-object asset. Modifier-evaluated overall bounds differ from recorded local bounds by at most a few centimeters; the difference may reflect bevel/solidify modifiers and warrants coordinator review only if strict bounds parity is required.

Exterior photos support two visible storeys and pitched roof form. The GIS one-level/12 extrusion attributes conflict with the photos and have no vertical-unit definition; model height and exact eave/ridge/chimney dimensions remain estimates.
The collection-only export reopened successfully in Blender 4.5.15 without cameras/lights or external libraries. The asset is authored and tested on the same Blender 4.5.15 line.
scope: Fresh independent assessment of the current rebuilt AAARCC asset, canonical builder inputs, source records, manifest and master placement. Source files and shared indexes were not modified.
